lab_title: Who may see this source version?
lab_assumptions: One candidate, local current metadata, no generation call or latency model. Unobserved upstream revocations are outside the fixture guarantee.

diagrams.title: Before: durable preparation
diagrams.description: The existing platform can enqueue and complete work, but cannot retrieve current authorised internal policy.

diagrams.title: After: ingestion to authorised context
diagrams.description: Source content is untrusted. Connector/worker roles publish versioned passages. Trusted policy/version checks gate text before the external model boundary. Objects and index are local fixtures here.

diagrams.title: Document and question lifecycle
diagrams.description: Observe, preserve, publish, retrieve, recheck, cite. Deletion or revocation blocks context; no evidence is not a fabricated answer.
